reason: I trust my POS vendor and I would rather wait for them to add ordering than bring in a new system from a company with no restaurants live yet. Friday and Saturday are my busiest nights and I cannot have my staff keying every order twice.
objection: My staff still ring every order up on the POS, so Sora adds work on my busiest nights, and I would be the first pilot restaurant for a company nobody has seen working. My older customers also want a waiter and a paper menu.
would_change_my_mind: Direct POS integration that sends orders straight into my POS, plus a live restaurant like mine that I can visit and see working on a Saturday night.
